suggestions.title: The Matrix
suggestions.description: A computer hacker discovers reality is a simulated world created by machines to subdue humanity — the Wachowskis' groundbreaking, mind-bending sci-fi masterpiece that redefined action cinema.

suggestions.title: Forrest Gump
suggestions.description: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ unwittingly influences several defining historical events in 20th-century America — Robert Zemeckis' heartwarming, Oscar-winning classic starring Tom Hanks.

suggestions.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
suggestions.description: Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and teams up with Spider-People from across the multiverse to save reality — a visually groundbreaking, Oscar-winning animated triumph.
suggestions.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
